summary.name: AI Gahaku
summary.one_liner: AI Gahaku is a photo-to-painting tool that turns your photos into artworks in the style of famous painters such as Van Gogh, Monet and Warhol.
keywords: make photo look like oil painting
use_cases: turn a photo into a famous-painting style artwork
make pet portraits in old master style
create art prints or wall pictures from landscape photos
use a painting as a reference for your own artwork
explore art styles like ukiyo-e or watercolor on personal photos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI portrait generator that converts a user's photo into a painting in a chosen artist's style, naming Van Gogh, Monet and Warhol. It says the app offers over 300 styles, including Renaissance, ukiyo-e, watercolor and anime. Users can choose one photo and flip through styles to compare results. Generated pictures are saved to a library inside the app. The page also mentions support for pet photos, with dogs and cats painted in old master style.
notable: 300+ painting styles including Van Gogh, Monet, Warhol and ukiyo-e
Pick one photo and browse all styles
